notes.title: 1.0.9 - A few more fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Some dormant spells were not properly showing the amount of progress needed before added to your drive
[*]Fixed a bug where harmless research beasts still removed portal shield
[*]Fixed a bug where research beasts caused damage indicators to show up on walls they didn't damage
[*]Dormant spells you cannot execute are now greyed out when loaded
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.8 - Full crash bug fixed
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the game to lock up or crash if a certain sequence of viewing your spells and showing the help page was inputted
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.7 - More big fixes, small balance tweaks
notes.content:
Unrelated to this patch, but Steam Cloud Save wasn't working properly. It's now been fixed!

[list]
[*]Mod Stasher now costs 5 Energy, and cannot be found at the Spell Smuggler
[*]Fixed a bug with Ghoulfry that would lock up the turn
[*]Menacebeam now costs 4 Energy but applies 2 Exposed
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.6 - Even further launch bug hotfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Nanobot Essence now activates when executed like all other boons
[*]Boons now blink like curios when activated
[*]Heatmist Bottle now hits enemies that spawn during turn 3
[*]Fixed a bug where a completed "Dormant" spell would cause a softlock instead of awakening
[*]Put the explanation of "Junk" spells in a separate section of the Help Page
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.5 - More small tweaks
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Mainline Murkcode can now kill beetles
[*]Fixed some small UI issues and typos
[*]"Hiding" enemies no longer damage walls in front of them
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes - More small bugfixes, threat level tweak
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Tweaked threat level amounts for Challenge Modes 1-4 to make them more forgiving
[*]Fixed a bug with Grim Cesta that caused it to never trigger
[*]Fixed a bug where the final boss wouldn't spawn if you faced it twice in the same play session
[/list]

notes.title: Small patch 1.0.3 - More bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would lock up at night 5, 100% upload with no boss
[*]Fixed a bug where the Juvenile Sprite would give you cards from previous runs
[*]Decreased Transfuse's energy cost to 0
[*]Fixed a bug where some Curios would stop the nighttime clock from advancing
[/list]

notes.title: More Small Fixes - 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with Precision Firetosser
[*]Set the intro page and main menu to scale properly with ultrawide monitors 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.0.1
notes.content:
Just a small patch for some day of release bugs!

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the wrong spell is given to the player by Neon
[*]Enemy health no longer blinks if no damage is done by a spell
[*]Fixed Festering Wax to properly decrease 3 energy
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes no boss would spawn night 5
[/list]

notes.title: SPELLHACK!! is out now!!
notes.content:
SPELLHACKERS!!

The time has come! [b]SPELLHACK!! is available to play right now![/b] Doom City needs your help, and only you can hack these spells.

To celebrate the launch, the game is 20% off!

This has been a huge labor of love, and it's very surreal to finally send it out into the wild.


The full version of the game includes:
[list]
[*]     A Story Mode to ease into the pace and mechanics 
[*]     A Challenge Mode with 5 levels to really test your skills! 
[*]     150+ Technospells to collect and install 
[*]     50+ Summoned Beasts to repel 
[*]     A huge variety of items to collect and events to encounter 
[*]     Graphics so good you'll forget its just a game 
[*]     Characters with no ulterior motives! 
[*]     And more!! 
[/list]

I hope you enjoy it!

- Computer Dream (Andreas)

notes.title: SPELLHACK!! works great on Steam Deck!!
notes.content:
Hey Spellhackers!!

We're just [b]ONE WEEK[/b] away from release! 

Just wanted to make a quick post that SPELLHACK!! works great on Steam Deck, no Proton fiddling or workarounds needed! SPELLHACK!! was designed with controller play in mind, so it's all seamless.

[b]One suggestion[/b]: In the settings menu, turn on "Zoom Camera". This is an option for playing on smaller screens that gives the in-game CRT more screen real estate. Then you're good to go!

That's all for now. Super exciting that we're nearly at release!


Can't wait for you all to hack all these spells.
- Computer Dream

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE!!
notes.content:
Hey Spellhackers!!

Over the past couple months, there's been a few small updates to the demo, but this is a big one!

[b]There's been a full redesign of the damage mod system.[/b]

Instead of +1 Mods and Lethal Mods, you can now gain Stable Mods and Quick Mods. In the new system, the damage added is the total of your Stable and Quick mods combined, so you can expect to pull off some crazy combos!

But, there's a catch, only Stable Mods will stick around if you don't use them. You'll lose any Quick Mods you didn't use at the end of each turn. So plan carefully!

That's all for now, keep an eye out for an even bigger demo update before the Steam Next Fest in October!!

As always, if you have any feedback, ideas, etc please check out the [url=https://discord.com/invite/BGrbk27eh5]Discord[/url]!

- Computer Dream

notes.title: SPELLHACK!! has a demo!!
notes.content:
Yo Spellhackers!!

[b]SPELLHACK!! Now has a free demo for you test your skills![/b]
It's been a long time coming, and I'm happy to finally share it with the world!

A run in the demo is about half the length as in the final game, and the events available during the daytime are limited. However, a large number of Technospells and enemy Beasts are available to play with! Please consider wishlisting the game if you enjoyed the demo!

I plan on keeping the Demo up indefinitely, and updating it while working on the full game.
If you have any feedback, ideas, etc please join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/BGrbk27eh5]Discord[/url].

Until next time!

- Computer Dream
